_README: fp16 patch table for Krea 2 on Kaggle T4 (Turing / SM75, no bf16).
text_encoder_preprocess  NO MATCH  (optional -- dtype= arg covers it)
vae_preprocess           NO MATCH  (optional -- VAE_dtype= arg covers it)
The two required patches have no argument-level equivalent, so they stay
required and the server refuses to boot without them. The two optional ones
are belt-and-braces: load_model already accepts dtype and VAE_dtype, and the
post-load sweep casts whatever survives. Do not mark them required again

patches.name: dtype_override
patches.replace: # dtype = torch.bfloat16 # Patched for FP16 on T4
patches.note: The hardcoded bf16 override. Commenting it out lets the fp16 dtype passed into load_model win.

patches.name: transformer_preprocess
patches.note: Chains onto the existing preprocess_sd rather than replacing it -- that one does quanto unpacking and must still run first.

patches.name: text_encoder_preprocess
patches.note: Optional. Did not match Wan2GP @7f06022 -- the call signature moved. Covered anyway: load_model takes dtype=float16 directly, and the post-load fp16 sweep catches anything left.

patches.name: vae_preprocess
patches.note: Optional. Did not match Wan2GP @7f06022. Covered by the explicit VAE_dtype=torch.float16 argument to load_model, confirmed present in the signature, plus the post-load sweep.
